reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible's annotators read Psalm 35's curses as a plea for God's justice and glory rather than personal vengeance, leaving Exodus 23's enemy-kindness law intact.

sides.snippet: If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
sides.verseText: \"If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

sides.snippet: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
sides.verseText: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
